title: LACCO: Local Accumulation with Computation--Communication Overlap
abstract: arXiv:2611.17991v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training language models across low-bandwidth networks requires reducing synchronization overhead. Local optimization methods such as DiLoCo communicate only after several local steps, but outer gradient averaging and the outer update remain on the critical path. Existing computation-communication overlap methods avoid this stall through delayed or replica-local updates, which can degrade convergence or cause replicas to drift. We propose LACCO (Local Accumulation with Computation-Communication Overlap), a two-stage algorithm that overlaps global communication with local computation while applying globally aggregated updates shared by every replica, without introducing staleness in the outer update. We establish convergence guarantees for smooth non-convex objectives. Experiments on language-model pre-training with FineWeb show that LACCO consistently outperforms communication-overlapped baselines such as Eager and Delayed DiLoCo. These

translated_title: LACCO：带计算-通信重叠的本地累积
translated_abstract: 在低带宽网络上训练语言模型需要减少同步开销。诸如 DiLoCo 等本地优化方法仅在执行若干本地步骤后才进行通信，但外层梯度平均和外层更新仍然处于关键路径上。现有的计算-通信重叠方法通过延迟更新或副本本地更新来避免这种停滞，但这可能损害收敛性能或导致副本之间产生漂移。我们提出了 LACCO（带计算-通信重叠的本地累积），这是一种两阶段算法，它将全局通信与本地计算重叠，同时应用由所有副本共享的全局聚合更新，而不会在外层更新中引入陈旧性。我们为光滑非凸目标建立了收敛性保证。在使用 FineWeb 数据集进行的语言模型预训练实验中，LACCO 持续优于 Eager 和 Delayed DiLoCo 等通信重叠基线方法。
tldr: 提出LACCO两阶段算法，在不引入外层更新陈旧性的前提下实现计算与通信重叠并保持各副本更新一致性，在语言模型预训练中持续优于Eager和Delayed DiLoCo等通信重叠基线。
en_tdlr: LACCO is a two-stage algorithm that overlaps computation and communication while applying consistent globally aggregated updates without introducing outer-update staleness, consistently outperforming communication-overlapped baselines like Eager and Delayed DiLoCo in language model pre-training.
